baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated equality construction at word 2 directly compares the two definite participant labels at words 3 and 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: A two-place equivalence test is denied because one participant lacks ocular access while the other possesses it.

activation_trace.role: Sets a direct equivalence test whose negation organizes the contrast.
Supplies loss of ocular access as one side of the comparison.
Supplies active ocular perception as the contrasting capacity.

changed_reading.before: A bare pairing of two human labels.
changed_reading.after: A denied equivalence between absence and presence of visual access.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The participant labels at words 3 and 4 each have a branch extending from bodily sight into inward apprehension.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same comparison can oppose loss of inward orientation to penetrating recognition, making the unequal capacity epistemic and ethical rather than merely anatomical.

activation_trace.role: Keeps the two inward conditions under an explicit non-equivalence relation.
Moves the absent capacity from the eye to the heart, judgment, and guidance.
Provides inward verification and penetrating knowledge as the positive capacity.

changed_reading.before: A contrast between physical disability and ordinary sight.
changed_reading.after: A contrast between confused inward judgment and truth-penetrating discernment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The blindness root at word 3 includes loss of wayfinding in an unmarked place, while the comparison root at word 2 includes a known middle or just position.
baseline_models.mechanism: Non-equality becomes a difference in navigational competence: one condition leaves the field without usable landmarks, while the other can locate a course and a discriminating position.

activation_trace.role: Contributes an unmarked terrain in which a route cannot be found.
Contributes a positioned midpoint or fair location against which orientation can be tested.
Supplies informed recognition capable of turning signs into a route.

changed_reading.before: Two fixed sensory statuses are compared.
changed_reading.after: Two unequal capacities to orient within an uncertain field are compared.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The blindness root at word 3 includes both deliberate obfuscation and a dense obscuring medium.
baseline_models.mechanism: Blindness can be a produced condition in which something interposed confuses or blocks apprehension, not only an intrinsic lack in the perceiver.

activation_trace.role: Supplies an act that makes an object or meaning confused to its recipient.
Supplies a dense intervening medium that blocks or darkens access.
Supplies the inward penetration that an obscuring layer prevents.

changed_reading.before: Blindness is an unchanging property of a person.
changed_reading.after: Blindness may also name an obscuring process or medium imposed between a person and what is to be known.

context_deltas.mechanism: An act can be cosmetically improved in appearance, actually perceived, and then judged good while remaining bad. The focus contrast therefore separates perceptual occurrence from calibrated discernment.

activation_trace.role: Allows blindness to operate through induced confusion rather than absent sensory input.
Makes inward verification, not bare visibility, the relevant positive capacity.
Adds an appearance-altering operation that can make the underlying act look attractive.
Keeps the underlying material bad despite its improved presentation.
Confirms that an act of ocular or inward seeing can occur inside error.
Supplies the positive judgment that reverses the bad act's actual quality.

structural_cues: In 35:8 beautification precedes seeing, and seeing precedes the judgment of goodness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies beautification, a bad act, seeing, and a good judgment; I infer that truthful calibration distinguishes the focus parties, while a live alternative is that the seeing verb only reports subjective opinion.

changed_reading.before: The seeing party is simply the party in whom perception occurs.
changed_reading.after: The seeing party is the one whose perception remains answerable to reality; perception itself can coexist with blindness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same non-equivalence formula is applied to two materially different sources, after which usable provision and adornment come from both. Non-equality therefore need not mean that one side has no yield at all.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the changed reading in the focus's denied equivalence.
Repeats the same equivalence test over a pair of unlike material sources.
Adds edible provision as a usable output from the contrasted field.
Adds adornment as a second valued output drawn from that field.

structural_cues: 35:12 repeats the focus's opening comparison syntax and then distributes two outputs across both sources.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unlike waters and benefits taken from both; I infer that denied equivalence does not erase every shared capacity or value, while the alternative is that the marine comparison does not constrain the person-level contrast.

changed_reading.before: Non-equality implies a total hierarchy in which only one side has value or productivity.
changed_reading.after: Non-equivalence can coexist with shared yield, so the focus need not deny every common capacity or worth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ayah joins nontransferable burden, responsive awe toward what is hidden from eyes, and self-purification. Seeing in the focus is thereby recast as accountable response without direct visual possession.

activation_trace.role: Provides inward recognition as the focus capacity that can operate beyond direct eyesight.
Supplies a heavy burden that remains attached to its bearer.
Supplies an affective response of awed fear rather than detached observation.
Places the object of response outside ordinary ocular availability.
Turns apprehension into self-directed purification and repair.
Locates the consequence in the person's own self rather than a transferable proxy.

structural_cues: 35:18 stands immediately before the focus and repeats self-reference while denying transfer of burden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hiddenness, responsive fear, self-purification, and individual burden; I infer an accountable mode of seeing, while the alternative is that these are qualifications of warning rather than a gloss on the focus contrast.

changed_reading.before: Seeing means possessing directly visible evidence.
changed_reading.after: Seeing means responding truthfully and self-accountably even when the relevant reality is hidden from the eyes.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier dead field is enlivened, and the focus is immediately extended through illumination, shelter, heat, life, death, and caused hearing. Blindness and sight can therefore describe states within an environmental and vital system of receptivity, not isolated organs alone.

activation_trace.role: Contributes an obscuring atmosphere that makes perception depend on surrounding conditions.
Keeps actual perceptual access as the focus anchor within the wider system.
Supplies the transition of dead terrain into living productivity.
Adds illumination as a condition that makes vision operational.
Adds protective cover as an inhabitable environmental condition.
Adds opposed thermal exposure, broadening contrast beyond a single sense.
Repeats denied equivalence over living and dead states.
Supplies animate life as the receptive side of the renewed comparison.
Makes reception causative and relational by introducing the act of enabling another to hear.

structural_cues: 35:20 supplies uncited darkness opposite cited light because its matching darkness branch is absent from the packet inventory.
35:22 places life and death under the same comparison formula and follows them with enabled hearing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies revival, paired environments, life and death, and caused hearing; I infer a dynamic ecology of receptivity, while the live alternative is that the analogies only reinforce a fixed contrast and do not imply transformability of the focus states.

changed_reading.before: Blindness and sight are self-contained, fixed properties of two people.
changed_reading.after: They can be states of receptivity embedded in obscuring or illuminating, exposing or sheltering, deadening or enlivening conditions.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rendered disclosure and illumination lead into a command to see patterned differences of color and kind, which then culminate in knowledge and reverent response. Sight becomes discriminatory literacy rather than indiscriminate visibility.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in penetrating recognition rather than visual registration alone.
Supplies meaning made clear through communicative signs.
Supplies illumination as the medium of disclosure.
Directs ocular or inward attention toward the displayed field.
Contributes divergence into distinguishable courses rather than a flattened sameness.
Turns visible color into differentiated kinds that can be read.
Supplies disclosure arriving as knowledge in the knower.
Makes reverent affect an output of rightly read differentiation.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from clear and illuminating communication in 35:25, to directed seeing and repeated variation in 35:27, to knowledgeable fear in 35:28.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosure, illumination, directed seeing, variation, knowledge, and fear; I infer a pedagogical sequence in which seeing reads meaningful difference, while the alternative is that the examples independently demonstrate creative power.

changed_reading.before: Sight is a binary possession that merely separates two classes.
changed_reading.after: Sight is the practiced ability to distinguish patterned plurality and let those distinctions become knowledge and response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's positive descriptor later belongs to the divine knower of servants, while inheritors of communicated knowledge are distributed across self-damaging, middle, and advancing responses. The binary becomes an axis observed comprehensively and inhabited by degrees.

activation_trace.role: Provides the focus's inwardly knowing descriptor for later rescaling.
Adds knowledge of reports and inner realities to the divine observer.
Reassigns penetrating sight to the observer of all servants.
Places transferred knowledge or scripture in the hands of the differentiated recipients.
Supplies a middle position rather than either binary endpoint.
Supplies an advancing position that makes responsiveness gradable.
Closes the surah with comprehensive discernment directed toward the servants.

structural_cues: 35:31 predicates the focus descriptor of God over servants; 35:32 immediately enumerates three responses among selected inheritors; 35:45 repeats the divine descriptor at closure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine discernment and a threefold human distribution; I infer that the focus binary marks an evaluative axis rather than an exhaustive taxonomy, while the alternative is that the later triad categorizes a separate matter.

changed_reading.before: The focus exhaustively divides people into two self-evident classes.
changed_reading.after: The focus establishes an axis of discernment under comprehensive divine observation, while actual recipients can occupy middle and advancing degrees.

context_deltas.mechanism: Seeing becomes an accountable proof procedure: attention is summoned, a showing is demanded, and a clear textual warrant is offered as the relevant alternative to unsupported claims.

activation_trace.role: Anchors demonstrative seeing in informed recognition and verification.
Supplies an interrogative summons to attend and assess a claim.
Supplies the demand that claimed agency be made showable.
Provides an organized written object as a possible public warrant.
Requires meaning to be disclosed through an intelligible sign.

structural_cues: 35:40 tests the claim through created effects, a share in the heavens, or a clear basis in a book before exposing mutual promises as deception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies interrogation, requested showing, written warrant, and clarity; I infer a public evidentiary standard for the focus's seeing, while the alternative is that these are rhetorical challenges without a general epistemic method.

changed_reading.before: Seeing is a private capacity possessed by an individual.
changed_reading.after: Seeing is also the ability to demand, present, and assess publicly intelligible evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: A claim to superior guidance is followed by the arrival of warning and increased recoil. The blind side of the focus can therefore be a resistant response after signal arrival, not merely deprivation before evidence.

activation_trace.role: Anchors recoil in loss of inward guidance rather than bodily incapacity.
Supplies a warning intended to awaken caution and response.
Supplies the claimed capacity to be gently directed toward truth.
Supplies active distancing from the very signal that was requested.

structural_cues: 35:42 reverses a conditional boast of greater guidance when the anticipated warner actually arrives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies claimed guidance, arriving warning, and increased distancing; I infer resistant orientation as the connecting arrow, while the alternative is that recoil names affective discomfort without deliberate refusal.

changed_reading.before: Blindness is an innocent absence of available guidance.
changed_reading.after: Blindness can be enacted as recoil from guidance after a warning has become available.

context_deltas.mechanism: Looking is joined to recurring historical patterns, travel through the land, and examination of outcomes. The focus's seeing becomes longitudinal inference from traces rather than an instantaneous glance.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the method in insight capable of drawing knowledge from observed traces.
Directs sight or insight toward an object to be understood.
Supplies a recurring path or established course that makes events comparable over time.
Makes movement through the evidentiary field part of the act of seeing.
Turns travel into directed examination rather than mere passage.
Makes the end-state or consequence the object from which judgment is drawn.

structural_cues: 35:43 asks about an established pattern, and 35:44 follows with movement, looking, and the fate of predecessors.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies directed looking, a recurring course, travel, and outcomes; I infer a historical method of perception, while the alternative is that the passage only offers retrospective warning rather than redefining sight generally.

changed_reading.before: The seeing party recognizes what is immediately in view.
changed_reading.after: The seeing party travels, compares recurring patterns, and reads consequences across time.

surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The blindness root at focus word 3 includes material that rises conspicuously over a surface.

activation_trace.role: Supplies a conspicuous upper layer that can obstruct access to what lies beneath.
Activates the surface mechanism by making an underlying bad act appear attractive.

changed_reading.before: Blindness means that too little is visible.
changed_reading.after: Blindness may arise because a salient surface is excessively visible and masks the underlying reality.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping from the focus blindness root to a form-distant branch about a person appearing to view; it remains valid as a supplied root-level activation sharpened by the demand to show in 35:40; downstream prose should mark it as a subject-object thought experiment, not as a proposed derivation of the focus label.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus contrasts the participant at word 3 with the perceiving participant at word 4, while the split inventory lets word 3 activate mere appearance to another viewer.

activation_trace.role: Contributes a person who becomes visible as an object without thereby becoming a discerning subject.
Supplies the active perceiving pole against passive visibility.
Activates the distinction by demanding that an alleged reality be made visible to a judging subject.

changed_reading.before: The focus compares two subjects who differ only in perceptual capacity.
changed_reading.after: The focus can experimentally contrast being an object that appears with being a subject who actively apprehends.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because weapon, thick-edge, and stitched-hide branches are materially distant from ordinary insight; it remains anchored in the focus sight root and gains a contextual echo from protective clothing in 35:33; downstream prose should retain it only as an analogy for insight that protects and joins evidence, never as the primary lexical sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus sight root at word 4 includes branches for protective equipment and for joining thickened edges.

activation_trace.role: Supplies protection interposed between a person and damaging impact.
Supplies the joining of edges into a tougher, integrated boundary.
Activates the protective dimension through clothing that functions as defensive covering.

changed_reading.before: Insight is only an inward beam that reveals an object.
changed_reading.after: Insight can be imagined as protective integration that joins signs into a boundary against deceptive impact.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus form ordinarily points to blindness while the cited branch concerns choosing and aiming; it remains anchored in the supplied focus-root inventory and is activated by claimed guidance turning into recoil in 35:42; downstream prose should qualify it as a volitional resonance, not claim that the focus word literally means deliberate choice.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The blindness root at focus word 3 contains a branch in which narrowing onto a chosen target excludes alternatives.

activation_trace.role: Supplies selective aiming that can turn non-seeing into a chosen narrowing of attention.
Provides the available direction toward truth against which narrowing occurs.
Provides enacted distancing after the directing signal arrives.

changed_reading.before: The blind party simply cannot access a direction.
changed_reading.after: The blind party may, in an exploratory volitional register, narrow onto one aim by actively distancing from the offered direction.

strongest_changes: 35:8 separates the occurrence of seeing from truthful discernment by showing perception captured by beautified error.
35:12 shows that denied equivalence can coexist with valued yield from both contrasted sources.
35:18-22 relocates sight into unseen accountability and a wider ecology of illumination, shelter, life, and enabled reception.
35:25-32 turns sight into the reading of meaningful difference under comprehensive divine observation while preserving graded human responses.
35:40-44 makes sight demonstrative and historical practice, while 35:42 preserves the possibility of recoil after warning.
summary.what_was_special: The repeated comparison formula, deceptive seeing, shared output across unequal sources, later divine uses of the focus sight root, and the packet's material and split-root branches prevented the ayah from collapsing into one flat physical-versus-spiritual metaphor.
remaining_uncertainties: The earlier revival of dead land may make perceptual states transformable, but the immediate life-death comparison can also be read as reinforcing fixed difference.
The shared-yield logic of the two waters may constrain person-level hierarchy, or it may remain local to the marine analogy.
The divine sight descriptors in 35:31 and 35:45 may directly rescale the focus's human descriptor, or they may function as independent closures.
The surface, subject-object, protective, and intentional outliers are live analogies but remain form-distant and should not displace the stronger readings.
